name: MATHVISTA
description: MATHVISTA is a dataset designed to evaluate mathematical reasoning intertwined with visual understanding, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks that focus primarily on textual contexts. It includes multiple tasks and topics, diverse visual contexts, and varying levels of challenge to assess the limitations of current models.
publisher: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024
citeAs: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024

creator.name: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, JaidedAI, and other contributors

rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by compiling 28 existing multimodal datasets, including 9 MathQA datasets and 19 VQA datasets, as well as creating three new datasets (IQTest, FunctionQA, PaperQA) specifically designed for evaluating various reasoning types. Examples were selected based on heuristic rules to filter for mathematical reasoning and were manually annotated for quality control.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:annotatorDemographics: Eligible human annotators must have a satisfactory annotating history, successfully pass qualification examples, and possess a high school degree or higher.
rai:responsibleAIMetadata.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating AI assistants' capabilities in mathematical reasoning and visual understanding across various tasks such as figure question answering, geometry problem solving, math word problems, textbook question answering, and visual question answering.
